env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the agent generates an action that is executed in the environment, which then returns the updated state and reward for the next decision
env_context_strategy.note: Agent perceives environment only through observations returned by env.observe()/step().

context_compaction.note: RolloutHandler appends full history each turn; no compaction described. Token length capped by data.max_response_length.

observation_format.note: WebArena accessibility-tree-like text rendered as plain text observations.

tool_call_format.note: Actions are free-text environment commands parsed by the environment server, not provider function calls; closest listed value chosen, mismatch noted.

tool_count.note: Tool/action count varies per environment; not stated.

edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool; environments are web/game/embodied/search.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: provides diverse scenarios via a standardized server–client architecture with unified HTTP protocols
protocol_standardization.note: Custom HTTP env protocol; no MCP/A2A mentioned.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: AgentGym-RL is a new framework to train LLM agents for **multi-turn** interactive decision-making through RL.
loop_primitives.note: Multi-turn agent-environment interaction inferred as react-style loop from README prose; loop code not in excerpts.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: with support for advanced mechanisms such as long-horizon planning and self-reflection
planning_granularity.note: Planning appears only in model free-text reasoning; no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Our current framework primarily targets single-agent training.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Our current framework primarily targets single-agent training.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: It also handles historical messages, status and reward.
short_term_state.note: RolloutHandler keeps message history plus score/status.

long_term_memory.note: Each episode resets the environment; no cross-run memory described.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: a full-reset interface in WebArena, which restores each web server to its initial state after every episode
state_persistence.note: Training checkpointing exists for model weights (checkpoint_manager.py), but agent runs are not resumable.

self_verification.note: Environment reward is used for RL training, not as a harness verification/repair step on agent output.

retry_policy.note: One rollout per task id; parallel sampling (sample_num) is for RL group sampling, not retry after failure.

rollback.evidence_quote: a full-reset interface in WebArena, which restores each web server to its initial state after every episode
rollback.note: Episode-level environment reset, not within-run rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: `algorithm.rounds_ctrl.rounds`: Maximum number of allowed interaction turns.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: `data.max_response_length`: Maximum total token length of the interaction trajectory (excluding the task prompt).

timeouts.evidence_quote: `algorithm.rounds_ctrl.rounds`: Maximum number of allowed interaction turns.
timeouts.note: Only turn caps documented; no time limits found in documented arguments.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: provides diverse scenarios via a standardized server–client architecture with unified HTTP protocols and parallel requests
execution_isolation.note: Actions execute in separately launched environment servers reached over HTTP.

network_policy.evidence_quote: enables LLMs to interact with search engines and solve multi-turn retrieval and reasoning tasks
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism described; environments make HTTP/search calls.

permission_model.note: Model output is passed straight to env.step with no authorization layer.

replayability.evidence_quote: It allows for the replay and examination of full interaction trajectories
replayability.note: UI replays recorded trajectories for inspection.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: You can see the evaluation example scripts for each task in the `examples/eval`.

guardrails.note: No filtering or action-policy layer described in the rollout loop.
